title: The Tiny Habits Method and Why It Works: The Small Change Question
description: The Tiny Habits Method and Why It Works can help you build consistent habits without relying on motivation alone. Learn how small actions, behavior change psychology, and simple habit systems reduce resistance and make personal growth easier to sustain. Discover why tiny behaviors create identity shifts, how routines become anchors, and the exact After I [existing routine], I will [tiny behavior] structure used to design new habits.
